stage: one of undivided devotion, even of bad conduct
description: One who worships the Lord with undivided devotion, even if of very bad conduct, quickly becomes righteous (dharmātman) and attains lasting peace (śaśvac-chānti); the Lord's devotee does not perish (BhG 9.30–31).
The Lord is the same to all beings, none hateful or dear to him; but those who worship him with devotion are in him, and he is in them (BhG 9.29).

stage: the knower (jñānavān), a great soul (mahātman), at the end of many births
description: The knower who, at the end of many births, takes refuge in the Lord in the knowledge 'Vāsudeva is all' (vāsudevaḥ sarvam) — a great soul very hard to find (BhG 7.19).
